chunks: Hadith 2500 — And the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said:
"Whoever settles in a place where he fears a wild beast, and says: 'I bear witness that there is no deity except Allah, alone, with no partner for Him,
'To Him belongs the dominion, and to Him belongs all praise,'
'and He is powerful over all things,'
'O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil of every wild beast,'
then he will remain safe from the harm of that wild beast until he departs from that place, if Allah, the Exalted, wills."

key_terms.أَشْهَدُ: I bear witness; a formal testimony of faith and conviction
key_terms.أَعُوذُ بِكَ: I seek refuge in You; a plea for divine protection
key_terms.شَرِّ: harm or evil feared from a threat
key_terms.قَدِيرٌ: all-powerful, fully able over every thing
key_terms.لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ: there is no deity except Allah; the declaration of tawhid
key_terms.ٱلسَّبُعِ: a wild beast or predatory animal
key_terms.ٱلْحَمْدُ: all praise and gratitude due to Allah
key_terms.ٱلْمُلْكُ: sovereignty and dominion belonging entirely to Allah

ai.seo_question: What should one recite for protection when staying in a place where wild animals are feared?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a supplication and declaration of tawhid for one who stays in a place where wild beasts are feared. It presents seeking refuge in Allah through remembrance, testimony of divine unity, and trust in His power as a means of protection.
